chapters.title: Chapter 2230 The Infinite Plane! I
paragraphs: 2230 The Infinite Plane! I
Would everything occurring right now be enough to put Noah on the same scales of power as Theseus and Desiderius if not even greater?
As if to answer his questions, the Quintessential Resonance between his Origin, Clones, Reality, and the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality only became more pronounced as even more prompts flowed in.
<The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality has begun devouring the Source of Reality at an exponential scale.>
<The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality is gazing at the countless Probabilities of possible Reality that are about to undergo destruction.>
The Apocalyptic Parallel Path that arose and continued to expand after Noah's actions.
The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality turned its hungry gaze towards different versions of Reality as...
<The very Sources of all remaining Parallel Paths are being drawn towards the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality through the Source of Reality.>
A truly magisterial and ridiculous action.

It was the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality stating that as its Master had begun on this path that caused the birth of all these Apocalyptic Parallel Paths, it would finish this path and absorb all possible versions of Realities!
To the extent that there would be no Parallel Paths.
HOONG!
It could not be put into words just how much the inflow of essence and reality into the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality had reached at this moment.
Quantifying it would be indubitably hard as one of the only ways for Noah to know just how ridiculous everything was becoming...was the next prompt that smashed down.
<You have devoured enough of Reality and gained the authority to rename it under your grandeur!>
The Barren Lands!
What the Ancestors left behind- a place that contained one Major Plane of Existence and 9 Minor Planes that they used to suppress it.
It did not have to remain the Barren Lands any longer.

The Quintessential Kainos Emperor could Designate a different name for this Plane entirely as when he looked at how his Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality had already devoured the 9 Dimensions and was now devouring the rest of Reality, all of the Barren Lands were bound to be a part of his ever growing
Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.
The construct that continued to devour the spaces it wasin as its hunger was endless.
"Then it shall be termed simply."
WAA!
Noabh's will reverberated out as the blinding lights of radiance that he emanated only became more astonishing.
"The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality and all the Planes it has devoured...and all the Planes it shall devour in the future- they shall all fall under The Infinite Plane."
Not the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.
Not the Barren Lands.
The Infinite Plane!
<The Undefined Construct- The Infinite Plane, is being formed.>
<Your Connection to The Infinite Plane has become Quintessential.>
<You share a close and unbreakable link to The Infinite Plane and the Planes of Existence within it.>
<The Path you're walking across has become clear.>
Amidst the torrential waves of surging authority and light, Noah's Aeonic Soul felt like it saw a shining point of light turn on.
A light that showed the way forward...a light that illuminated his Origin and caused his 9 Dimensional Realities to shudder.
A feeling of euphoria coursed through him as this was it.

This was what he sought the most amidst all of his other motivations- just for the moments where during his exploration and understanding of the reality around him, he stripped apart all the veils of secrecy and attained things he could barely imagine!
He loved this feeling of grasping fantastical things and concepts that even those who had lived for billions of years could not have!
<Your Realm is slowly being defined.>
The ever constant symphony of the Protagonist playing in the background picked up the pace as resonant drums rose to a glorious crescendo.
And an even more glorious prompt came down.
<You're establishing the First Plane of Extremity as your Origin.>
The First Plane of Extremity!
eαglesnᴏνel This...was the Realm that Noah was in currently!
Others could Designate him as being on the stage of Boundary Expansion like all organisms seeking EXTREMITY.
In this manner, he would have labels similar to Desiderius who was an 8 Echelon Obsidian Boundary Expansion Existence!
Yes, he was seeking EXTREMITY...but he did not seek it the same way as others.

He did not simply expand Boundaries towards EXTREMITY and strengthen his Aeonic Soul to incredulous levels, he started by establishing a fantastical Foundation that was paving the way for his Origin to be established as the First Plane of Extremity!
A type of Origin that Noah was only now exploring its information as it seemed full of glorious wonder.
<The First Plane of Extremity resonates with the Construct of The Infinite Plane.>
<Planar Essence from the Source of The Infinite Plane has begun flowing into your Origin.>
<Your established First Plane of Extremity is undergoing an expansion!>
<Your Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Empyral Foundation is undergoing Quintessential Advancement!>
WAA!
His Origin that was dormant this whole time after completing the 9 Dimensional Realities began to pulse with majesty.

Each of the 9 Dimensional Reality engrossed the waves of Planar Essence from The Infinite Plane that contained 9 Minor Planes and was currently absorbing a Major Plane- the wisps of Reality being drawn in across the Major Plane and the Parallel Paths having a portion of its vast reserves surge into Noah's Origin!
His Kainos Royal Cosmos began to surge upwards exponentially as 200 Trillion became 300 Trillion, and then another 100 Trillion was added as the explosion of essence was truly too abundant!
The Planar Essence of multiple Planes surging into the single Origin of one being!
His Origin- the First Plane of Extremity, expanded to a shocking degree and it devoured everything being given to it as it truly went towards establishing itself as the First Plane of Extremity.
And even as he expanded his Origin and his power bloomed upwards...
<Further advancement of your Realm is possible after the establishment of the First Plane of Extremity.>

<Once three conceptual Boundaries seeking EXTREMITY and have achieved the 6th Boundary Layer are designated as the Sources of Extremity and bound to your Aeonic Soul, your First Plane of Extremity will be capable of advancing.>

chapters.title: Chapter 2231 The First Plane Of Extremity! I
paragraphs: 2231 The First Plane of Extremity! I
A glorious path was outlined before him while his Origin expanded speedily!

His 9 Dimensional Reality pulsed with glorious Colors as each one boasted 400 Trillion Kainos Royal Cosmos, dense waves of energies and power emanating from each as the Stanchions and Reality Passages connecting them also underwent Quintessential changes.

His designated Realm as the First Plane of Extremity was of course something that was immensely hard to raise, where just for it to be capable of advancing where it currently was, Noah had to achieve the 6th Boundary Layer in three different Boundaries and bind them as the Sources of Extremity to his Origin.
It was all closely connected as everything...went towards the Extremity!
This was just for his First Plane of Extremity which contained 9 Minor Planes within it.
eαglesnᴏνel He knew not of what the Second Plane of Extremity came with, nor what he would be able to enact there.
He only knew he had to keep going forward as he sensed his robust Origin and Physique!
<Your Reserves of the Essence of Reality have been elevated to the Maximum of 1056 Billton.>
<The newly established First Plane of Extremity has defined its additional augmentations from here on out to be in line with the Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Empyral Foundation.>
<A dense life force and reserves of resources course through your Origin.>

<The First Plane of Extremity is currently providing you an additional +500 Aeonic Damage and Defense Values, and +500 Aeonic Vitality Values that are capable of being augmented by the multiplier of All Aeconic Parameter Value.>
<Your status as an Infinite Conduit continues to evolve.>
<Your Heart of Mana is transforming.>
THUMP!
His Heart.

Noah actually felt a great pain at this moment as if his very heart was being ripped away from his body, but it was simply the initial and unexpected motion of cerulean tendrils of vessels shooting out from his Heart of Mana and fantastically...latching onto the Fundamental Treasures of Nature that were within his Body.
<The Quintessential sources of authority coursing through you are leading everything towards the most optimal direction.>
<Your Heart of Mana has begun fusing with the Heart of Reality, Heart of Destiny, Heart of Fate, Heart of Fortune, and Heart of Karma!>
<Your Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Empyral Foundation is being Quintessentially elevated.>
His Heart of Mana undertook a drastic action to devour the very Heart of Reality and four other Fundamental Treasures of Nature.

It was something utterly glorious as apart from this, one had to account for the fact that Noah's Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Empyral Foundation was something that put together his constructs, Concepts, Heart of Mana, and everything else about Noah's existence and expressed their Boons through it.

Last time, his Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Empyral Foundation had expressed the might of the Heart of Mana and the extent he could act as the Infinite Conduit, where apart from his Infinite Mana...he was allowed to cast all abilities requiring less than 10 Aeonic Soul Value at no cost or strain to his soul!
So as multiple Hearts in his body were brought and fused into the Heart of Mana, a cerulean radiance covered his body as even his True Throne of Quintessence was painted blue momentarily!
<The Heart of Mana has fused with the Fundamental Treasures of Nature and become the Aeonic Heart of Mana.>

The radiance was utterly overpowering as it seemed Noah's very musculature, bones, and organs were bathing in utmost radiance and authority. He felt as if the very secrets of Nature coursed through his arteries, veins, and capillaries.
And truly, golden multicolored viscous splendor coursed through his vessels as the Hematopoietic source of Blood from his very bones burned with an unbelievable stellar radiance.
<Your Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Empyral Foundation has undergone a Quintessential change and transformed into the Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Extremity Foundation.>
His body...oh his body!
His very skin was shed and replaced multiple times over as he gained deeper hues of a stellar glow, the changes inside of him being more profound as his muscles became even more refined!
His abdominal muscles seemed like slabs of the very fabric of Reality as his face continued to attain unreasonable levels of beauty.

<Your Body has achieved the equivalent hardness of an Epoch IV Relic and can passively defend against 500 Aeonic Damage Values, with a movement of any part of your body being able to release 500 Aeonic Damage Values. Your Aeonic Soul can also passively release and defend against 250 Aeonic Soul Damage Values at no cost or strain. These Values are capable of being augmented further by the multiplier of All Aeonic Parameter Value.>
<Your Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Extremity Foundation allows you to cast all abilities requiring any resources of Mana, Fortune, Karma, Destiny, Fate, or Essence of Reality at no cost.>
WAA!

When the Fundamental Treasures of Nature were drawn into and fused into the Heart of Mana, the glorious result of Noah being capable of utilizing Infinite Fortune, Karma, Destiny, Fate, and Infinite Essence of Reality was brought to fruition!
It was an ecstatic and fantastical show of utmost grandiosity and majesty as this was only a small part.
<Your Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Extremity Foundation allows you to cast all abilities requiring less than 250 Aeonic Soul Values at no cost or strain to your soul.>
The ridiculousness continued as the question of whether Noah would be able to stand before Theseus and Desiderius with the boons of this upgrade were slowly getting answered.
His Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Extremity Foundation alone was granting immense firepower as when paired up with what his Origin granted...
Stupendous possibilities came into the picture!
And this was before the wonders of his Boundaries seeking the stage of Innate even came!
But the Boons of his First Plane of Extremity were not done.

<The First Plane of Extremity allows you to traverse towards EXTREMITY with an additional +50% Increased Rate of Progression. Any Resources required to exceed a Boundary Layer are absolutely further reduced by half.>
A boon that was granted for his Lineage before when it became Planar!
Now, the same boon was granted by his Origin as he was even more specialized and primed to seek EXTREMITY!

chapters.title: Chapter 2232 The First Plane Of Extremity! II
paragraphs: 2232 The First Plane of Extremity! II

One fantastical thing after another came as the start of his First Plane of Extremity, the changes of his Heart of Mana, and everything else just sculpted Noah into an extremely terrifying existence as the largest boons were yet to come.
<The newly formed Aeonic Heart of Mana has pulled from the boons of the Fundamental Treasures of Nature and gathered them all towards the seeking of Extremity.>
<Your Origin has pulled from the Source of your Aeonic Heart of Mana to bring forth the capability of Extremity Treasure Generation.>

<Within your First Plane of Extremity, treasures capable of aiding you towards EXTREMITY will naturally begin to form. The more advanced your Origin becomes, the faster the rate of formation for these treasures and the more potent they become.>
Noah nearly shifted from his Throne at the advent of such a prompt as it was...too broken!
It utterly defied everything other beings were trying to do as Noah spat on all their efforts.
He was already capable of going towards EXTREMITY at a 100°o faster rate due to his Lineage and Origin.
But now, his own Origin would naturally form treasures that allowed one to get even closer towards Extremity?
Was this not what all beings risked their lives to wade through the Havens of Extremity for?
Was this not why the Ancestors abandoned and suppressed the Desolate Mausoleum for?!

<At the current level, Extremity Treasure Generation can fully form a random Treasure with low potency within a week. When your First Plane of Extremity has advanced further and begins binding Sources of Extremity, even faster rates of Generation and potency will be attained.>
BZZT!
Noah felt his Origin pulse.
From the sandy gold of the Dream Dimensional Reality, multicolored tendrils of liquefied authority began to rise and increase in concentration.
They were covered by a golden glow of utter majesty as they twirled around the Reality Passages and Ascendancy Stanchionssnaking upwards from the Dream Dimensional Reality!

From this First formed Layer and onwards, tendrils of these multicolored authority covered by a golden glow traveled upwards through Reality Passages and Ascendancy Stanchions until they reached the Elysium Dimensional Reality, and then atop Elysium...all of it began to converge onto a point of a singularity!
<The passive Process of Extremity Treasure Generation has begun within your First Plane of Extremity. Time remaining until complete Generation: 7 Days...>
A wondrous process began as Noah's tyrannical will felt extreme euphoria.

What had begun to be formed above his Dimensional Realities was unknown to him, nor what its effects would be compared to things like the Golden Boundary Modulators that he attained from enemies he didn't devour the Blood of.
But it was something Noah wholeheartedly looked forward to as he also...wanted to compare it to what Lineages of the past Barren Lands and the NOBLESSE were all seeking!
Others had to risk their lives to wade through the Vaults of Extremity to obtain what he would obtain in 7 days just from waiting.

If he had the mindset like most other monstrous beings that lived for billions of years, he would have hidden himself for a few billion years to accumulate treasures that could bring one closer towards Extremity every week, continuing to bring multiple Boundaries towards EXTREMITY as this would trigger a positive feedback that would only elevate the rate and potency of treasures forming within his Origin!
But...Noah was not like the vast majority.

He wouldn't need Billions of years to do what he wished to and to achieve the same grand states as others, and his path of exploring the mysteries and wonders out there were what led him to his fast progression!

If he had simply hidden in the small blue planet or the Primordial Cosmos, he would have yet to begin swallowing Realities, much less Dimensions, nor meet any of the beings that he devoured the memories and existence of to arrive where he was today.
He wouldn't have come across Lavalliere and her initial boons as she now returned to be Eowyn, nor would he come across the Sword of Avalon, or the beings that exposed him to NULLITY and Boundaries!
The Infinite Planes would not be what it was today. He would not be where he was today!

He needed to continue advancing while exploring the fantastical things out there as on this day...his stellar fountain was laying down the building blocks for him to do so successfully and with a great deal of power.
The boons were miraculous even now as they elevated him to a stage that made him ready to enter the Planar Palisades of Extremity and see what else lay out there for him to conquer!
And these boons had yet to end as the last of the boons relating to his body and Origin came out.

<Your First Plane of Extremity has gained sufficient control of the Dimensions within it as after communication with your Lineage and the Boundary of Blood, the capability to fuse your 9 Quintessential Dimensional Chassis into their respective Dimensional Realities inside your Origin has been born. This capability has given way to the feature of Aeonic Sanguine Plane Fusion.>

<The true value, resource cost, and augmentation of initiating Aeonic Sanguine Plane Fusion are unknown, with a grasp of its nature only being capable when you initially activate it for the first time.>
No words needed to be said.
No words could be said!
On this day, Noah could take all of his True Sanguine Clones that had become Quintessential Dimensional Chassis and fuse them into his Main Body.
The cost was unknown.
The duration was unknown.
The results of such an action were unknown!
The elevation and grandness Noah was attaining now...it felt unlike any other elevation he had gone through before.
And...all of these were boons initiated by the assimilation of the last Dimension into his Infinite Planes, but they were not thorough and complete.
His body and Origin had advanced upwards greatly as there was one more thing that was utterly critical to Noah, as well as all beings seeking EXTREMITY.
It was his Soul.
His Aeonic Soul Value had been snaking upwards explosively as it had long since exceeded 1,000 and simply continued to rise, and now with all of the transformations occurring...
<The Constructs attached to your Aeonic Soul are undergoing Quintessential transformation.>

They were covered by a golden glow of utter majesty as they twirled around the Reality Passages and Ascendancy Stanchionssnaking upwards from the Dream Dimensional Reality!

From this First formed Layer and onwards, tendrils of these multicolored authority covered by a golden glow traveled upwards through Reality Passages and Ascendancy Stanchions until they reached the Elysium Dimensional Reality, and then atop Elysium...all of it began to converge onto a point of a singularity!
<The passive Process of Extremity Treasure Generation has begun within your First Plane of Extremity.
Time remaining until complete Generation: 7 Days...>
A wondrous process began as Noah's tyrannical will felt extreme euphoria.

What had begun to be formed above his Dimensional Realities was unknown to him, nor what its effects would be compared to things like the Golden Boundary Modulators that he attained from enemies he didn't devour the Blood of.
But it was something Noah wholeheartedly looked forward to as he also...wanted to compare it to what Lineages of the past Barren Lands and the NOBLESSE were all seeking!
Others had to risk their lives to wade through the Vaults of Extremity to obtain what he would obtain in 7 days just from waiting.

If he had the mindset like most other monstrous beings that lived for billions of years, he would have hidden himself for a few billion years to accumulate treasures that could bring one closer towards Extremity every week, continuing to bring multiple Boundaries towards EXTREMITY as this would trigger a positive feedback that would only elevate the rate and potency of treasures forming within his Origin!
But...Noah was not like the vast majority.

He wouldn't need Billions of years to do what he wished to and to achieve the same grand states as others, and his path of exploring the mysteries and wonders out there were what led him to his fast progression!

If he had simply hidden in the small blue planet or the Primordial Cosmos, he would have yet to begin swallowing Realities, much less Dimensions, nor meet any of the beings that he devoured the memories and existence of to arrive where he was today.
He wouldn't have come across Lavalliere and her initial boons as she now returned to be Eowyn, nor would he come across the Sword of Avalon, or the beings that exposed him to NULLITY and Boundaries!
The Infinite Planes would not be what it was today.
He would not be where he was today!

He needed to continue advancing while exploring the fantastical things out there as on this day...his stellar fountain was laying down the building blocks for him to do so successfully and with a great deal of power.
The boons were miraculous even now as they elevated him to a stage that made him ready to enter the Planar Palisades of Extremity and see what else lay out there for him to conquer!
And these boons had yet to end as the last of the boons relating to his body and Origin came out.

<Your First Plane of Extremity has gained sufficient control of the Dimensions within it as after communication with your Lineage and the Boundary of Blood, the capability to fuse your 9 Quintessential Dimensional Chassis into their respective Dimensional Realities inside your Origin has been born.
This capability has given way to the feature of Aeonic Sanguine Plane Fusion.>

<The true value, resource cost, and augmentation of initiating Aeonic Sanguine Plane Fusion are unknown, with a grasp of its nature only being capable when you initially activate it for the first time.>
No words needed to be said.
No words could be said!
On this day, Noah could take all of his True Sanguine Clones that had become Quintessential Dimensional Chassis and fuse them into his Main Body.
The cost was unknown.
The duration was unknown.
The results of such an action were unknown!
The elevation and grandness Noah was attaining now...it felt unlike any other elevation he had gone through before.
And...all of these were boons initiated by the assimilation of the last Dimension into his Infinite Planes, but they were not thorough and complete.
His body and Origin had advanced upwards greatly as there was one more thing that was utterly critical to Noah, as well as all beings seeking EXTREMITY.
It was his Soul.
His Aeonic Soul Value had been snaking upwards explosively as it had long since exceeded 1,000 and simply continued to rise, and now with all of the transformations occurring...
<The Constructs attached to your Aeonic Soul are undergoing Quintessential transformation.>

chapters.title: Chapter 2233 The Quintessential Aeonic Curator! I
paragraphs: 2233 The Quintessential Aeonic Curator! I
<The Constructs attached to your Aeonic Soul are undergoing Quintessential transformation.>
The constructs attached to his soul.
His Traits!
His Infinite System!
Anything else that his soul was wrapped around was pulled into the transformation!
Noah was undergoing a thorough overhaul of everything about him as this juncture truly was Quintessential.
<The Sub-construct of the Infinite Resources has been incorporated into the Aeonic Heart of Mana.>
<The Sub-construct of the Infinite Dream Physique has been incorporated into the Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Extremity Foundation.>
<The Sub-construct of the Infinite Dream has been transformed into the Aeonic Dream of Extremity.>
<The Sub-construct of the Infinite Forge has been transformed into the Aeonic Forge of Extremity.>
<A Quintessential connection is shared between the Infinite Forge and the Extremity Treasure Generation of the First Plane of Extremity.>

Some constructs were already displaying their features through greatly elevated parts of Noah as they were incorporated as a whole, while others had enough to stand by themselves as they were elevated stupendously!
This included Infinite Dream becoming the Aeonic Dream of Extremity and the Infinite Forge becoming the Aeonic Forge of Extremity. But...just how Quintessential were these changes?
Noah's luminous will blazed as it honed in on the Aeonic Dream of Extremity.

<Aeonic Dream of Extremity>:: Your Aeonic Soul has begun to touch upon the mysteries of the eons, gaining the authority for you to wade across the Planar Palisades of Extremity within your Dreams and evade the countless dangerous things within it. Only existences exceeding the 6th Boundary Layer will be capable of sensing and possibly injuring your Aeonic Soul during your dreams. While traversing with the Aeonic Dream of Extremity, only a tenth of your power can be displayed asitis also possible to place an Anchor in a certain point of space within the Planar Palisades of Extremity for you to teleport to. Apart from the Planar Palisades of Extremity, you cannot yet stretch your Aeonic Soul into the Havens of Extremity, but you can wade into any Minor and Major Planes of Existence you come across. It is possible to increase the authority of the Aeonic Dream of Extremity through having your Boundaries get ever closer to Extremity....
Noah eyed the Aeonic Dream of Extremity carefully as if utilized well, it could rise to be a terrifying weapon!
This was something to put a focus on after he controlled the fires burning in his home.
He was about to continue gazing at the description of the next boom that was the Aeonic Forge of Extremity when suddenly, his Aeonic Soul that was undergoing a
revamp of everything connected to it...opened a pathway that was simply too shocking.
<Your Traits have been centralized and incorporated into your Aeonic Soul and Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Extremity Foundation.>

The preceding prompt was unique as it referred to his Traits, where his Infinite Mana Trait was something that similar to his Infinite Resources Sub-construct...it was all centralized into the capabilities of the Aeonic Heart of Mana.
This also applied to the Traits of Samsara Universal Dao Origin and Protagonist!
Yet even though their Reality Altering capabilities were absorbed into other parts of Noah, there was still something else that rose from the Ashes.
<You have touched upon the infinitesimally outer layers of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity and gained the Trait of a Quintessential Aeonic Curator.>
BOOOM!
This.
This was what stopped everything as a point of Singularity bloomed in his very soul.
He touched upon the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!
Something he knew nothing of- and something that somebody like him should never be given access to!
Even if it was only the infinitesimally outer layers of these Annals of Extremity.
But on top of all this, he also gained the distinction of Quintessential Aeonic Curator!

The point of a singularity that exploded in his mind caused his Aeonic Soul Value to instantly double and exceed 2,000, his mind feeling stretched and compressed at the same time as he felt a link be established for something exceedingly old, ancient, and untouchable.
Boundless waves of information flowed in.

<Aeonic Annals of Extremity>:: A Record of eons that have come and gone. Very little of it can be currently quantified, with the limited knowledge gained due to a mixture of factors of your Existence coming together to grant you access to an infinitesimal portion of the records of the outer layers of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity. Due to its nature, it is a Record that is commontly only accessible to those exceeding the 7th Boundary Layer of a Consummate Boundary. It details all things appearing across Extremity as even those who can access an infinitesimal portion of it have advanced far compared to those who do not even know of its existence....
His soul felt a connection to something that seemed so far away.
Something he could access and at the same time, he could not!

Something that only pristine existences who had a Consummate Boundary- a Boundary above Planar and Innate, that they also had to exceed the 7th Boundary Layer just to touch...he had actually gained access to something like this.
BZZZT!

His soul felt like it was Ascending across Layers and layers of countless Planes to touch something that was extremely far away, and yet it was also so close as it pervasively wrapped around everything across Extremity!
To better understand just what he had come across, he needed to gaze upon the other critical piece of information.
His new distinction and Trait- the Quintessential Aeonic Curator!
This should have been the ability that came due to his constructs of the Protagonist Trait and I Am the Main Character.

<Quintessential Aeonic Curator>:: The history of all things is recorded over the eons. Through your Reality Altering constructs of focusing yourself as an existence thatis at the center of revolving events, you have managed to earn the distinction of the Curator of your own History. The cost and true extent of the Quintessential Aeonic Curator ability is unknown, but it will allow you to manipulate your presently unfolding history- your story that is being written in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity....

chapters.title: Chapter 2234 The Quintessential Aeonic Curator! II
paragraphs: 2234 The Quintessential Aeonic Curator! II
The details of the Quintessential Aeonic Curator were being quantified in real time and being displayed before Noabh's eyes!

<Quintessential Aeonic Curator>...Depending on the amount of Aeonic Soul Value provided, you can even catch a glimpse of your future history in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity. Glancing upon the History of others is nearly impossible unless one has advanced extremely close to Extremity or attained Extremity in a concept, with the manipulation of the History of others in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity being something only possible when one has multiple concepts at Extremity...
Austere waves of possibility rose before his eyes as Noah calmed down and stared at everything closely.
The features shown before him were similar to the capabilities stemming from the Protagonist Trait, but they went even further into something as pristine as the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
And he...had gained the distinction of not just any Aeonic Curator- but a Quintessential Aeonic Curator!
This new tool interested him greatly.

His Main Body was currently seated upon the True Throne of Quintessence in the Source of Reality as it shifted slightly, the stellar transformations occurring within his body continuing as his Will commandingly went towards a single aspect.
<Quintessential Aeonic Curator>.
HUUM!
His Aeonic Soul buzzed.

Aeonic Soul Values began to be used up by the hundreds just to initiate this skill, with Noah counting 500 Aeonic Soul Values spent before a blinding singularity flashed that took a portion of his soul to an entirely different location!
He could neither say that this location was extremely far away nor that it was very close.
Distance did not matter to it as it could be accessed so long as one had gained the authority to do so!
Noabh...appeared in the fringes of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity that strictly involved him.

Before his eyes, Runic Ecritures formed into pillars of multicolored light and floated in a radiant space, the incomprehensible authority of Extremity flowing serenely in this space as Noah's soul felt a shuddering tug just from being near it.
Around these Runic pillars of light, a myriad of stellar golden, Obsidian, and Crimson colored scrolls floated in space as each of them held different contents!

The golden scrolls had a single designation above them that read (Genesis), while the obsidian scrolls had the destination of (Chrysalis), and the stellar crimson scrolls that were all entirely empty were labeled [Extremity]!
Genesis, Chrysalis, and Extremity!

These were the stages that Noah's life was designated to, where as his soul stepped closer towards his own Aeonic Annals of Extremity, he could see more clearly the contents within the floating scrolls.
The stellar gold section that had the designation of Genesis was Noah's beginnings.
When he was born.
When he first opened the Fireball Skill Book and became a hunter.
When he waded across the Blessed Empire, Beast World, and Atlantis!
When he traversed the Seas of Ruination and the Primordials Cosmos!
When he speedily crossed the Firmaments of Ascendancy.
Everything he did was neatly outlined into the stellar golden scrolls of light as the events stopped at a certain point.
The History of his Genesis stopped not too long ago at the time right before he expanded his first Boundary towards EXTREMITY!
Since then, everything he had done was recorded under the designation of [Chrysalisy]!
This word meant development, advancement, maturation, or expansion.
It was a stage for those expanding their limitations and evolving into something incomprehensible as they sought EXTREMITY.
Noabh...barely had a page of these radiant scrolls filled under Chrysalis.
He had just stepped onto another stage of his life as his journey was far from over.
Because even when one reached Extremity and entered this stage...there were countless scrolls to fill up!
So his eyes blazed as they focused all his soul on the Chrysalis designation of the stellar Obsidian scrolls.
eaglesnovɐ1,сoМ He gazed at the myriad of scrolls that had many more smaller designations until his eyes landed on [Boundary Expansion].

He could feel Aeonic Soul Values being drained the closer his soul floated towards these scrolls, where when he was perusing over the events he had already done like expanding his Boundaries of Loot, Quintessence, and others...there was a stabilization.
But then, his Soul peered to his right where there were unfilled pages.
Events that had yet to happen!
HUUM!
His Aeonic Soul burned as 300 more Aeonic Values were used up.
And then...radiant Obsidian white words began to be etched on the scrolls before him on what was to come.

[...After his grand accomplishments and transformation of his existence, the True Emperor of Quintessence was taken a step further as his Boundaries finally finished their elevation and came into the picture.
<The Obsidian Innate Boundary of Blood has been born.>
Obsidian.
Innate!
The same stage as the NOBLESSE Lineage that made these existences terrifying against the Lineages of the past Barren Lands!
And this wasn't all.
<The Obsidian Innate Boundary of Quintessence has been born.>
<The Obsidian Innate Boundary of Loot has been born.>
One after another!
Majesty bloomed...]
Noah read the events on these pages with luminous eyes as he saw the fantastical future of what was to come.
This...was going to be a part of his History.
A part of his story!
It was already astonishing results as he was going to achieve multiple Boundaries at the same level as the NOBLESSE.
But...was this all he wanted for his story?
"No."
WAA!
His Will surged with boundless Tyranny as even more of his soul power flowed into the ability of Quintessential Aeonic Curator.
He was a Curator.
A Quintessential Aeonic Curator!
And he could write his own story.
He...wanted to change his coming History in his Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
Waves of his Quintessential Aeonic Soul surged.
Hundreds of Aeonic Soul Values began to burn as he looked at the term [Obsidian] under [Obsidian Innate Boundary of Bloody].
He instinctively knew that with the current strength of his Soul, he would not be capable of enacting a grand change in his Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
After all, the manipulation of Aeonic Annals of Extremity were things that only those with Consummate Boundaries exceeding the 7th Layer could do! And this was only for their own Recorded Histories!
What he was doing due to his unique distinction as the Quintessential Aeonic Curator was only using the strength of his Soul to change his own History.
Just the fact that he could do this alone was already balance breaking!
So he knew directly changing the rank of his Boundaries from Innate to Consummate was far out of reach for his current self.
But changing a tier within the ranking of Innate Boundaries?
HUUM!
Grandiosity blazed as he sought to change the single word of [Obsidian] to [Crimson]!

chapters.title: Chapter 2235 One Innate Boundary After Another! I
paragraphs: 2235 One Innate Boundary After Another! I

The True Emperor of Quintessence stretched his hands into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity as he utilized his identity as the Quintessential Aeonic Curator to change his very own future Recorded History!
The power of his Aeonic Soul burned as it surged towards the stellar Obsidian scrolls under the Chrysalis section.

His soul was currently undergoing Quintessential changes as his Boundaries surged towards greater levels, his Aeonic Soul Values continuing to increase as after crossing the 2,000 threshold, they now reached out towards 3,000 as this constant transformation was also replenishing used up Aeonic Soul Values.

The incandescent glow of Quintessence burned as he felt hundreds of Aeonic Values flow towards the simple action of changing the character [Obsidian] to [Crimson] for a single Innate Boundary of Blood.
HOONG!

His soul cried out as it felt the strain, his Main Body being drained of his Will for all of it to come towards his Aeonic Annals of Extremity as only then...did he see the fantastical change of words.
Like a dazzling flash of light.
Like the blooming of a singularity.
<You have directly used your Aeonic Soul to alter the Recorded History of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.>
<Your proficiency in the manipulation of the Recorded Histories of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity has slightly increased.>
<The Crimson Innate Boundary of Blood has been born.>

His soul was almost impossible drained after he first initiated the skill of Quintessential Aeonic Curator, then went ever closer to the section of Chrysalis, and then nearly 2,000 more Aeonic Soul Values were drained just to change a single word!
But the result...
Oh, the result!
It was the birth of an Innate Bloodline Boundary that even exceeded the VOID that the NOBLESSE were so proud of.
The birth of something that was right below Consummate!

The stronger their boundaries and the closer they were towards Extremity, the stronger their Aeonic Souls were. And the stronger their Aeonic Souls were, the easier they could refine their Boundaries towards EXTREMITY.

Now...Noah had nearly drained all of his Aeonic Soul Values to alter the result of a single Boundary from Obsidian to Crimson, and now...his drained and weakened soul felt an explosion due to the birth of such a tier of a Boundary!
What seemed drained, weak, and at abysmally low levels began to rebuild ever stronger as his Aeonic Soul Values refilled while his Soul became even stronger!
<Your Aeonic Soul is undergoing further Refinement and Strengthening.>
<The full effects of Aeonic Sould Refinement and Strengthening will occur over time as your Blood flows through you.>
<The elevation of your Lineage to the stage of a Crimson Innate Boundary has made it easier for you to traverse its layers towards EXTREMITY.>
<The previously established Boundary Layers of Blood are undergoing Quintessential Advancement.>

His soul was bathed with the unique authority of a Crimson Innate Boundary that was so pristine and rare across countless Planes of Existence as from the recently obtained Aeonic Soul Value of 3,000...an explosion towards 6,000 was the first result.
BOOM!
An explosion.
This was the only way to describe such a ridiculous rise in the power of his Aeonic Soul as apart from breaking its past limitations, the Aeonic Soul Values were refilled along the way!
The draining and weakening Noah had just experienced...was all erased as he came back stronger than ever.
And his hungry gaze then turned towards the same distinction of the character [Obsidian] to [Crimson] for the Boundary of Quintessence.
And the same character for the Boundary of LOOT!
Waves of his pristine Aeonic Soul surged to change them both simultaneously as his Aeonic Soul Value began to be used up again!
WAA!
<The Crimson Innate Boundary of Quintessence has been born.>
<The Crimson Innate Boundary of Loot has been born.>
The future Recorded History was altered in a grand fashion as within moments, three Crimson Innate Boundaries were born.
<Your Aeonic Soul is undergoing further Refinement and Strengthening.>
And his soul only cried out in Euphoria as it tore past the value of 9,000 and instantly began exceeding 12,000.
And all this....was just the initial strengthening of his Soul as it was stated the full grandness and effects of Innate Boundaries would show over time!

As his soul scaled upwards in power, it sought to see the full results of just how grand the changes were to previously established Boundary Layers of these Boundaries that had now attained the stage of Crimson Innate.
They were just below the Consummate level as how balance breaking would they now be?!
His tyrannical will sought out the grand Boundary of Blood first as information of its Layers surged in his mind.

<The First Boundary Layer of BLOOD>(Passive):: Uniquely geared to match the Quintessential Kainos Emperor, this passive Boundary Layer grants the boons of Aeonic Hemokinesis...To one self, Aeonic Hemokinesis can be utilized in an active fashion to spur the Blood within your Body to further optimize your power, granting you +300% to All Aeonic Parameter Values momentarily. This augmentation is ever changing over time as multiple factors of your Blood and Lineage will decide how high it can go...Due to a recent advancement of the Tier of the Boundary, the passive effect of Blood Boundary Suppression has been born. Any Boundary that is lower than yours in Boundary Layers or Ranking will give rise to its holder to feel a sense of suppression that reduces the power of their Boundary to an unquantified extent. A lower ranking Boundary that has exceeded this Boundary by two Boundary Layers will not be affected...
Majesty was displayed before him one of the biggest things to arise was a change from +100% to All Aeonic Parameter Values to +300%!

chapters.title: Chapter 2236 One Innate Boundary After Another! II
paragraphs: 2236 One Innate Boundary After Another! II
Apart from his power being scaled upwards so much, he could now display a Blood Boundary Suppression against those with Boundaries lower than his!
He would let his enemies know that they stood beneath him from his mere appearance alone.
This...was just the change of a single Boundary Layer from a Boundary that reached the Crimson Innate level!
Noah's will was expectant as he honed in on the second Boundary Layer of Blood.

<The Second Boundary Layer of BLOOD>(Passive):: The Blood of Existences carries their signature and very being. As someone extremely proficient with Blood, you are able to draw upon the very signature of beings through their Blood as if you devour the Blood of enough Existences holding a certain Boundary, you will be able to replicate upto the Second Layer of this Boundary. Bypass the countless epiphanies. Bypass years of Aeonic Soul Refinement. Bypass countless treasures. Achieve everything simply by devouring countless volumes of Blood...Due to the thorough advancement of the Boundary of Blood, the new feature of Blood Boundary Sacrifice has been born. You will devour countless rivers of Blood containing the signatures of countless Boundaries. Many of these Boundaries will not be up to par with the standards of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor as any Boundaries you obtained through the devouring of Blood can have their Boundary Layers completely erased, sacrificed, and applied to your selected Boundaries through Blood Boundary Sacrifice.
The transfer of Boundary Layers from one Boundary to another will have varying results depending on the rank of the sacrificed Boundary and the rank of the recipient Boundary....
From being able to obtain One Boundary Layer of a Selected Boundary to being able to obtain up to the Second Boundary Layer!
And then the addition of Blood Boundary Sacrifice as he could erase Boundaries below his standing and transform their Layers into Layers of other Boundaries.
It was a fantastical capability that made him want to devour as many Lineages as possible and direct all of the Layers of their Boundaries to Blood, Loot, and Quintessence.
And these were only the results of the elevation of one of his Boundaries to the Crimson Innate level!
Boundaries were each filled with their own unique aspects of power.
Offensive, Defensive, Support...whatever category a Boundary could be put into, it would ultimately become one that could display its might in all categories the closer it was towards Extremity.

One such example could be seen from the ongoing battle between the one who had laid down the VOID across the Infinite Plane and the ones fighting him- Hideyoshi taking a side bar as it was mainly the terrifying Sword Fanatic- Theseus!
Both beings held a terrifying understanding of Extremity and the Boundaries they were expanding.
And in the midst of their battle at this juncture...
SHIING!
Both of their respective authorities blazed with a blinding radiance as they simultaneously paused.
Waves of sword light that were cutting apart the very Plane of Existence buzzed and came to a halt.
Tentacles and amalgamations of terrors of the VOID wriggled eerily as they also came to a halt...Both of these beings feeling something with their Boundaries.

Desiderius felt it more so as he didn't have the tight bindings of the Natural Laws that had come to wrap around Theseus and Hideyoshi tightly- even with their Automaton Boundary Modulators and barriers of NULLITY keeping it at bay!
Their strongest Boundaries pulsed at this juncture as they were warned...of a very possible danger.
Danger!

This in itself was a shocking prospect due to their power, and beings who had elevated Boundaries at their level didn't need Providence or Destiny to foresee possibilities of their future as when they got a feeling of danger...they knew very well that it was real!
This was because when they faced each other, they didn't have bells of danger ringing.

It told them that they had both reached a terrifying height of power as even if one of them was stronger than the other, they might be able to escape if the battle progressed to a worse state as granting True Death to each other was going to be nearly impossible!
Yet now, their Boundaries warned them of danger.
It meant that an enemy had risen that could very well pose a threat to their very existence.
This...should have been an impossibility.
Desiderius's ancient face lost its smile as his eyes closed, connecting to the VOID he had spread out across this Plane.

Fantastically, Theseus also closed his eyes even with this terrifying enemy before him as a sword light flashed, sensing the very fabric of Reality and the direction it was surging towards as through their own means, these beings ascertained one thing.

For Desiderius, his ancient will swept past the VOID he had enacted as even across the folds of Reality, he searched until he found the one place apart from the current region he was in that wasn't affected by the VOID.
There, he felt a vast aura of magnificence that was swallowing everything around it.
The very fabric of the Plane of Existence they were on!
And it was here that he narrowed down the feeling of danger.
Theseus was able to do the same as the eyes of these beings opened at the same time, gazing at each other with serenity at this unexpected outcome!
Desiderius's deeply black eyes gave off no emotions as the ancientness within them had seen many things.

Among the experiences he had accumulated over the eons, he had many battles. In some battles, he had enemies that believed themselves superior by all accounts as they didn't put him in their eyes at all, and he ended up killing and devouring them while they expressed shock and rage on their faces.

At this moment, he brought forward his many years of accumulated knowledge as he allowed for the possibility to exist that the Key he had waited for to initiate his final plan may have grasped a unique power.
He changed his mindset as even though it did not make logical sense, nor did he truly believe it to be the case, there was no harm in him moving with care!
After all, even if the possibility was low, he didn't desire to be like the many beings he had devoured in the past who died with shock and incredulity.
He was too old to die like so.
Countless calculations were made in an instant as his Boundaries fed him bountiful information, and a path was formed before his eyes.
"It seems the Key I've regarded to be the same as all others has an unexpected anomaly. Since you must have felt it too...why don't we put this danger to rest first?"
BOOM!
His eyes void of light buzzed with ancientness as this NOBLESSE spoke like so towards an Ancestral Descendant!
And both sides considered the other as their True Enemy!
Theseus's eyes shone with sword light as he gazed at the NOBLESSE before him calmly.
They were true enemies, yes.
But the threat of possible True Death that even they could not feel when they faced each other...
<Just until this threat is eradicated.>
WAA!
A shocking development bloomed!
In the threat of the mere possibility of True Death, the Boundaries of the two organisms led them to a path that pointed their souls to work against a single enemy.
In the possibility of True Death, allies could momentarily become enemies while enemies could become allies!

chapters.title: Chapter 2237 One Innate Boundary After Another! III
paragraphs: 2237 One Innate Boundary After Another! III
<Impossible! Theseus, what is this?>

In the space where a dazzling sword light and an endless darkness were fighting for supremacy, Hideyoshi bellowed out as he gazed with incredulity at the scene of Theseus agreeing with a NOBLESSE on an issue!
Golden streams of Fate covered his hair and muscular body as he blazed with righteous power, his Legion coming to surround him as he continued to speak out.

<What can possibly arise to cause you to join hands with one of them? Our True Enemies! Katya has more than likely sent back word to the Abecedarian Sacrarium to let the Ancestors know as aid should be here the moment the Seekers know what has occurred. What can possibly cause you to join hands with a NOBLESSE!?>
A clear and true enemy.
This was what each side looked at each other as.
The NOBLESSE had killed too many of their people to ever think of even working with beings from this Lineage.
And Hideyoshi was nowhere close to the 6th Boundary Layer as even with such a Boundary as Fate, he was not able to feel the threat that Theseus and Desiderius felt!
So he questioned such a development.

The austere lights of incorporeal swords around Theseus became even denser as he replied without even looking towards Hideyoshi, his body coiling like a spring as he prepared to continue heading towards the same direction before he was stopped by the appearance of Desiderius.

<A danger capable of granting True Death even to me is rising. It is more than likely the same True Emperor of Quintessence that the Ancestral Seers missed. If he finishes whatever he is doing...the Will of the Ancestors may never be achieved.>
BOOM!
The moment his words finished, his coiled figure shot out as a flash of sword light bloomed- cutting apart everything before it!

Desiderius had his Obsidian Halos release a burst of light as he called upon the VOID laid out, his figure being wrapped by a spatial light as he traversed across the VOID to arrive where he needed to!
Hideyoshi and his Legion looked at this scene with incredulity and frustration as this True Emperor of Fate also shot out towards the same direction soon after, his forces following close behind.
Waves of Quintessence surged as Noah monitored his transformation while still connected to the Source of Reality.
<<Both the parties of Sealers and NOBLESSE are making their way towards the Infinite Plane.>>
The words from the Source of Reality were short and calm.
And as Noah heard them, he was even more calm as he felt the state of his Aspects of Existence!
His thoughts were computing at unimaginable speeds as not even a nanosecond was passing, his words serene as he gazed upon the last sets of prompts and details.
"Then...I shall give them a grand welcome."
Plans were set in motion as pieces began to move.

In Dilated Time and with thoughts moving faster than any average Boundary Expansion expert, Noah gazed at the last sets of Boons of his transformation as his eyes were on the next 2 Boundaries to achieve the Crimson Innate level after he manipulated his Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
<The First Boundary Layer of LOOT >(Passive):: All those targeted by the Boundary of Loot shall provide Loot equivalent to Aeonic Quintessential Treasure Caches.
For the Boundary of Loot, there was a change to the type of Treasure Cache as it went from <Quintessential Treasure Caches> to <Aeonic Quintessential Treasure Caches> for the First Layer!
As for the remaining layers...only the altered details in their descriptions were browsed as Noah got acclimated to the new changes.

<The Second Boundary Layer of LOOT >(Active):: ...Weak targets who cannot defend against the power of your Boundary that currently releases 300% of your maximum Aeonic Output will eventually find their Existence fading quickly and becoming Loot whenitis too late, while stronger targets....Activation of this Layer requires only 300 Aeonic Soul Value as a base, with the cost of activation changing when targeting stronger enemies...

<The Third Boundary Layer of LOOT >(Passive)::... It elevates your strength, allowing the Authority of LOOT to constantly refine and strengthen your Soul over time as another critical feature is the augmentation of +306% to All Aeonic Parameter Values...

<The Fourth Boundary Layer of no cost to you, any being designated as an enemy not just in your immediate surroundings, but so long as your Eyes or Will can gaze at them...they will begin to have their Aspects of Existence, Life Force, Concepts, and anything else that makes their being drained by you as quintessential loot...
"Oh my..."
Noah had to come to a stop.
He had to because of the changes in the Fourth Boundary Layer of LOOT!
Before, he could activate passive Loot Absorption on the enemies in his immediate surroundings.
Now, the enemies did not even have to be near him.
So long as he could gaze at them with his Will or eyes, he could passively absorb Loot from them! This was all on top of another ridiculous boost to All Aeonic Parameter Values of 306%!

It was a ridiculous capability as he could remain in the comfort of his own home and only look at his enemies from afar, drain them of their Aspects of Existence and turn them into Loot, and if they were weak enough... they wouldn't even know they were dying until it was too late!
Glorious was what it was.
Then, his eyes came to land upon the boons of the last Crimson Innate Boundary.
The one that defined him the most.

<The First Boundary Layer of QUINTESSENCE> (Passive):: ...The First Boundary Layer of QUINTESSENCE is a simple one as it seeks to make the Boundaries of its Master unequaled, directly increasing all your current Boundaries by one additional Boundary Layer. You can now designate one of your Boundaries to be f(Quintessential), directly increasing its rate of Progression towards EXTREMITY and increasing its Boundary Layers by another additional layer...

In Dilated Time and with thoughts moving faster than any average Boundary Expansion expert, Noah gazed at the last sets of Boons of his transformation as his eyes were on the next 2 Boundaries to achieve the Crimson Innate level after he manipulated his Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
<The First Boundary Layer of LOOT >(Passive):: All those targeted by the Boundary of Loot shall provide Loot equivalent to Aeonic Quintessential Treasure Caches.
For the Boundary of Loot, there was a change to the type of Treasure Cache as it went from <Quintessential Treasure Caches> to <Aeonic Quintessential Treasure Caches> for the First Layer!
As for the remaining layers...only the altered details in their descriptions were browsed as Noah got acclimated to the new changes.

<The Second Boundary Layer of LOOT >(Active):: ...Weak targets who cannot defend against the power of your Boundary that currently releases 300% of your maximum Aeonic Output will eventually find their Existence fading quickly and becoming Loot whenitis too late, while stronger targets....Activation of this Layer requires only 300 Aeonic Soul Value as a base, with the cost of activation changing when targeting stronger enemies...
<The Third Boundary Layer of LOOT >(Passive)::...

It elevates your strength, allowing the Authority of LOOT to constantly refine and strengthen your Soul over time as another critical feature is the augmentation of +306% to All Aeonic Parameter Values...

<The Fourth Boundary Layer of no cost to you, any being designated as an enemy not just in your immediate surroundings, but so long as your Eyes or Will can gaze at them...they will begin to have their Aspects of Existence, Life Force, Concepts, and anything else that makes their being drained by you as quintessential loot...
"Oh my..."
Noah had to come to a stop.
He had to because of the changes in the Fourth Boundary Layer of LOOT!
Before, he could activate passive Loot Absorption on the enemies in his immediate surroundings.
Now, the enemies did not even have to be near him.
So long as he could gaze at them with his Will or eyes, he could passively absorb Loot from them!
This was all on top of another ridiculous boost to All Aeonic Parameter Values of 306%!

It was a ridiculous capability as he could remain in the comfort of his own home and only look at his enemies from afar, drain them of their Aspects of Existence and turn them into Loot, and if they were weak enough... they wouldn't even know they were dying until it was too late!
Glorious was what it was.
Then, his eyes came to land upon the boons of the last Crimson Innate Boundary.
The one that defined him the most.

<The First Boundary Layer of QUINTESSENCE> (Passive):: ...The First Boundary Layer of QUINTESSENCE is a simple one as it seeks to make the Boundaries of its Master unequaled, directly increasing all your current Boundaries by one additional Boundary Layer.
You can now designate one of your Boundaries to be f(Quintessential), directly increasing its rate of Progression towards EXTREMITY and increasing its Boundary Layers by another additional layer...

chapters.title: Chapter 2238 One Innate Boundary After Another! IV
paragraphs: 2238 One Innate Boundary After Another! IV
The elevation of the Boundary of Quintessence was a fantastical one as the effect of its First Boundary Layer was changed to a truly daring one.
Noah could Designate one Boundary as Quintessential, where right after that... its Boundary Layers would experience yet another additional layer!
An example and a possibility of this was Noah's Boundary of Loot.
It was expanded to the Third Boundary Layer, but due to the effect of the Boundary of Quintessence, it showed its boons up to the Fourth Layer.
In the case that Noah directed the residual True Authority of Quintessence or the True Authority of this Era to raise Loot and bring it to Five Boundary Layers.
He could theoretically bypass the arduous and extremely impossible task of then achieving the Sixth Boundary Layer by simply designating Loot as [Quintessential]!
He could cross grand distinctions that required billions of years of hard work, talent, and treasures in such a manner.
It was a true example of Quintessence!

It caused Noah to begin altering his plans slightly as at this moment, his Will began to make commands on exactly where the residual True Authority of Quintessence and the True Authority of this Era would go towards.
And at the same time he did so, the last of the prompts came down as he would have to glean their details while he welcomed terrifying guests!
One prompt related to his Origin and the Infinite Plane as the other was a continuation of the capabilities of his Aeonic Soul continuing its transformation.
<The Crimson Innate Boundary of Dimensions has been successfully born and Quintessentially connected to your Origin.>
<The Feature of Quintessential Aeonic Skill Lineage Creation has been generated.>...
Prompt after prompt came as his Aeonic Soul explosively rose upwards once more, exceeding 15,000 as enemies came knocking on his door!
A flash of sword light was exceedingly fast when its target was set.
And when the being in question was in a constant state of epiphany of the Sword as he reached incredible heights in his Boundary, they were even faster.
SHIING!
Theseus tore across the folds of space as he followed the Source that the very fabric of Reality was coming towards.
And just when he was about to reach its periphery...his blazing light began to dwindle and materialize as he came to a stop.
This was because not too far in front of him, the visage of a particularly powerful existence could be seen floating in the VOID.
Golden in grandeur, the image of the True Emperor of Quintessence he had seen before appeared before him as this particular visage was wrapped in a sandy gold light.

Theseus could feel the potent aura of Absolute Dream Authority that was leaking around him in overabundance, this aura mixed in with the Authority of Boundaries as it caused this whole area to brighten up as if this being was a dazzling sun!
Sandy gold Emperor's robes adorned him as he stood in the void of space calmly, a floor of golden essence forming below his feet into a sea as the aura around him was just that potent!
Theseus gazed at this being coldly as he also turned to peer behind him where what seemed to be a massive point of a singularity was devouring every part of Reality around it.
And with his entrance here, it didn't take long as a moment later, space fractured as from the VOID a distance away, the terrifying figure of Desiderius also appeared!

The two of them had appeared, and yet this being had the picture of calmness on his face as he stared at each of them with radiant eyes, his words emanating out at this moment as they were filled with authority!
<Hey there.>
<Isn't it normally routine to let the other side finish powering up before you all attack?>
WAA!
His words were carefree as if he had absolutely no worries about this upcoming clash.

They caused Theseus to blaze with an even greater white gold light of sword light as the ancient visage of Desiderius came in closer, his eyes quizzically gazing at the construct far behind the True Emperor of Quintessence!
"What exactly did you do, little one?"
This being that had planned for too many years and waited patiently for eons was curious.
Just where had this Key turned into an anomaly that could actually pose a sense of danger?
And even though he stood before them, they still didn't feel as if this being in front of their eyes of the exact source of the danger they felt- more so he was a part of it!
"You've got all the Minor Planes in that space? And you're even trying to displace a Major Plane into it as well? What did you come across that I missed, O True Emperor of Quintessence?"
Even though he now moved with caution, the power and ancientness in his voice still remained!
He felt a sense of danger, yes. But he also foresaw opportunity.
If he could eradicate this danger, he would be able to grasp his hands on whatever made this Key anomalous enough to even pose a threat in the first place before he grew too much.
But he was still a being that had lived for too many years.
So he moved with care to ascertain the extent of power of this being before staking his might!
And this being smiled while turning his gaze towards
him.
<The one who stood hidden in the folds of Reality for eons, the oh so great Desiderius!>
WAA!

<Where did your pride and arrogance go? Aren't you the ancient being who was talking about how you would break all Keys at the end? Where is all that bravado for you to be rushing here now and yet standing so far away? Come, let me see the grandeur of NOBLESSE that I've heard so much about...>
A devilish smile grew wider and wider on his lips as he spoke.
His body seemed to contain an unimaginable power that was only rising at this moment, and it wasn't alone in this as multiple other aeonic signatures just like it began to appear one after another!

chapters.title: Chapter 2239 The 6th Boundary Layer! I
paragraphs: 2239 The 6th Boundary Layer! I
A variety of colors.
Adorned in Emperor's robes and shining with a potent allure of a Minor Plane.
Seas of essence formed below their very feet as they appeared and floated in this space that was gradually brightening up more and more!
These...were the Quintessential Dimensional Chassis of the True Emperor of Quintessence that appeared one after another.
The gazes of Desiderius and Theseus shone as they ascertained all parts of the puzzle.
The feeling of danger...it all came together radiantly when they looked at the 9 identical clones before their eyes!
The one surrounded by sandy gold waves of light that had appeared before them first gazed with eyes of immense coldness at this moment as his smile faded.
He gazed towards Desiderius and Theseus with such a high gaze as if the True Emperor of Quintessence exceeded them!
<You rushed over here to attack, why the hesitation to do so now?>
His were like a raw knife digging into their Aeonic Souls as the minds of Boundary Expansion existences were dynamic.

Theseus was a one of a kind genius in the Boundary of the Sword as even other Ancestral Descendant Commanders of his level did not know he far exceeded them, while Desiderius was a calculative being that had stayed behind for billions of years in the Source Plane of the Lineages of the Barren Lands that called themselves Ancestors in order to deal a killing blow!
Each of them had their duties, but beings at their Age... were truly too cognizant of the risk of Death, much less the genuine possibility of it.

The older and wiser that Boundary Expansion experts became, the more aware they were of death after seeing so much of it in the Vaults of Extremity as they...did everything in their power to avoid it.

Yes, each of them had their own purpose to stand before this True Emperor right now. But...neither of them wanted to throw their lives away as they tried to break down the level of risk and strength this being could display!
Just because he could pose a danger to grant them True Death, it only laid out this possibility. They had to understand just to what extent this danger was!
So before they jumped into battle, they cautiously discerned the 9 identical clones and any more surprises that may be coming.
"You are part of our Lineage.'
WAA!
Theseus was akin to a drawn sword that was waiting to spring as he built up waves of sword essence, his pupils also being sharp swords as he spoke freely!
"Your Lands are our lands, the Throne you seat on is part of the inheritance that our Ancestors left behind. You may not fully agree with their Will, but must you take things in this direction?"

As he spoke, lights began to flash as the Legion of True Emperor Hideyoshi arrived, the True Emperor of Fate having a stern gaze as he observed this stand off while his Legion formed into another formation around him.
The True Emperor of Quintessence didn't even spare a glance at them as his 9 clones floated closer and closer to each other until they stood in a wondrous line of power.
The smile on his faces had faded as callousness could now be seen, his voice ringing out to reply to Theseus as his words didn't even address his question- and he said another thing entirely!

<Theseus. For unquestionably following the Will of others to reap the lives of countless creatures in multiple Planes of Existence with the excuse of the lives of the many outweighing the importance of the few...you shall face death.>
The voice was filled with grandeur and authority as only Desiderius and Theseus were the ones capable of feeling the aura of this being gradually changing.
It caused their own gazes to change as they noticed...it was very similar to them who were infinitely close to attaining the Boundary distinction of crossing the 6th Boundary Layer threshold!
This being was actually going towards achieving such a level as he seemingly gave out verdicts at this moment!
<Desiderius. For plotting and killing these past eons while also planning to destroy 9 Minor Planes to achieve your own objectives...you shall face death.>
HOONG!
A rousing symphony began to play.
The words of the True Emperor of Quintessence rang out as they seemed like commandments to be followed.

Theseus and Desiderius were the only ones to closely feel the level of danger due to their power, with the newly arriving True Emperor of Fate...not liking that he wasn't even addressed as he harrumphed.
He was a True Emperor.
He had reigned over an Age!
He had played and manipulated fate countless times.

So he inserted himself into this standoff as with the visage of a NOBLESSE to his left and Theseus to his right, he didn't believe there was any great level of danger as his Legion surrounding him in a formation began to give off waves of light that would surge forward to attack!
"A mere being who slipped through the cracks wishing to deny Fate...you shall see that Fate is undeniable!"
SHIING!
Hideyoshi could not see any abysmal fates as he tested with his Boundary of Fate.
The thought that it was simply too low ranking to sense the dangers coming was not focused on too much as it wasn't Desiderius or Theseus- but this being who instead made the first move!
Because the sword of the foolish and ignorant always struck first!
The eyes of the clones of the True Emperor of Quintessence did not even gaze at Hideyoshi and his Legion, nor the attack that they were preparing.
He kept his eyes on Theseus and Desiderius who did nothing and had colder and colder gazes as they outweighed the risks and benefits of the fight to come as he spoke out serenely.
<You want them to test me out?>
WAA!
Noah could see their caution as these beings had yet to make a move.
They would get a better gauge of his power if he was forced to show exactly what he could do and the nature of the concept he was bringing towards EXTREMITY!
But...they would find out today that they had to face him themselves to see just to what extent he had grown!
<They cannot test me out. Because they...are already dead.>

chapters.title: Chapter 2240 The 6th Boundary Layer! II
paragraphs: 2240 The 6th Boundary Layer! II
He didn't even gaze in their direction when he spoke.
And yet his voice was akin to a booming drum in their hearts!
<They cannot test me out. Because they...are already dead.>
The moment his words finished, Hideyoshi's Legions underwent a great change as fantastically, the Essence they were gathering up to attack could not be mustered anymore.
The common Ancestral Descendants under Hideyoshi gaze down to see in horror that not just this, but their very limbs and bodies...were beginning to turn to ash.
Ash!
Seemingly before the True Emperor of Quintessence even made a move!
But he had.

Before Hideyoshi and his Legion had even arrived, Noah had made a move as his Will that was connected to the Source of Reality was able to gaze at these beings as he activated Passive Loot Absorption from afar!

They were being drained of their very existence and turned into Loot over the last few seconds as in shock, Hideyoshi turned all around him to see all his people incredulously turn into nothing but ash.

It caused him to touch his own body in shock as he affirmed such a thing hadn't happened to him, but he wasn't able to breathe a sigh of relief for too long as the grandeur of the True Emperor of Quintessence emanated out!
<Since you all will not make the first move, allow me.>
HUUM!
A pressure originating from the soul emanated out as Haki surged.
The Emperor's Haki that was a collection of Noah's very own Aeonic Soul Damage Values!
After so many transformations and boons of his Soul, merely releasing his pressure alone in the form of Haki had far exceeded the stage of a few hundred Aeonic Damage Values.
With his Soul alone, the mere release of his Will could now erupt out with over 4,000 Aeonic Soul Damage Values!
This was why he didn't even bother to gaze at the True Emperor of Fate who could not even read between the lines of Fate at this moment.
Because when his Haki descended and caused the very fabric of Reality to tremble, only Theseus and Desiderius blazed with authority as their Boundaries erupted out, while Hideyoshi...
BZZT

Felt as if the pressure of the whole Plane had descended unto him as his upper and lower jaws instantly crushed into each other, his teeth instantly fracturing from the soul pressure as without any defenses to stand against it, his very Aspects of Existence were crushed under the weight as the visage of this True Emperor...exploded into a river of blood an instant later that flowed towards a certain direction!
The Glory of the True Emperor of Quintessence shone with valor as without even gazing at a True Emperor, he was able to kill one with the pressure of his Soul alone!
It was a terrifying development as surprisingly, the blaring authority of the VOID surging around Desiderius and the white gold light of the Sword surrounding Theseus had protected them entirely.
At the same time, the tension and caution in their shoulders reduced somewhat as to them, they were able to ascertain the level of threat their enemy could pose.
They were both infinitely close to the 6th Boundary Layer as a majority of their Damage and Defense Values were geared towards the Soul!
Feeling the potent but stable release of 4,000 Aeonic Soul Damage Values from the True Emperor of Quintessence, their reservations towards the unknown reduced somewhat as this was manageable to them.

In fact, they could reach much higher as at this moment, the both of them decided to make their moves as since they were all surging towards the 6th Boundary Layer, the first one to do so would be determined to be the victor!

"Even if you are somewhat of an anomaly, I have put anomalies to rest before. I will study these 9 bodies of yours releasing auras of the Minor Planes and learn exactly how you were able to achieve your feats, O True Emperor of Quintessence. "
The ancient voice of Desiderius echoed out along with a terrifie move filled with Aeonic Soul Damage Values.
<Planar Void of Gehenna>.
HUUM!
Countless singularities bloomed around this being as the auras of multiple Boundaries could be felt within it, a miniature plane full of darkness and misery erupting and formingin a stellar fashion!
And at the same time...
<Planar Pantheon of the Halcyon Sword>.
Theseus erupted out.
Their Aeonic Souls were pulled upon as neither of them probed any further, releasing some of their strongest moves as they sought to erase the possible danger to their lives right away!

They felt somewhat safer after Noah released 4,000 Aeonic Soul Damage Values. What they didn't know...was that this was currently Noah's lowest damage value as he was only now heading towards the Sixth Boundary Layer.
His Damage Values were only now beginning to transform towards Soul Damage.

The Aeonic Damage Values not geared towards the soul that his Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Extremity Foundation could release paired with the All Aeonic Parameter Value augmentations from the Boundaries of Loot and Blood...had already crossed the 10,000 Barrier, and was barely settling upwards of 18,000 after his recent and thorough elevation of power!
He...had not even shown them his final form!
And even now, he had directed the remaining essence of the True Authority of Quintessence he attained as the prize for this Age towards none other than his highest Boundary.
He had viewed countless paths and chose this particular one as the hardship of going ever higher towards EXTREMITY only became more intense.
All the residual authority in his Throne was burnt up as Noah even had to pull from the True Authority of this Era that he was saving to elevate another Boundary.

His calculations were off as only after a third of this Authority was used up did he manage to bring the Boundary of Loot from its <True> Third Layer and into the Fourth Layer- and the distinction <True> was made because this was before the effects of the First Boundary of QUINTESSENCE that increased all his other Boundaries by an additional layer!
So Noah had truthfully only expanded the Boundary of Loot to the Fourth Boundary Layer, but because of the Boundary of Quintessence, it meant he had achieved the Fifth Boundary Layer.
He...was now close to cusp that showed a point of transformation for Boundary Expansion existences.
And when he got here, he knew that he would not have sufficient Boundary Modulators or Authority that would ever be enough to push towards the 6th Boundary Layer!
He saw the only path to do so with relative ease and quickness to be...the utilization of his Boundary of Quintessence to label the Boundary of Loot Quintessential.
To give it a second additional layer.

And so...he did just that as his Soul that had just completed waves of transformations cried out in joy, his existence going towards a pristine level while he faced two enemies who were infinitely close to reaching it too!
